segments.text: 各位观众,今天给大家带来的是 ACM UbiComp / IMWUT 2022 的论文《Revisiting Reflection in HCI: Four Design Resources for Technologies that Support Reflection》。
这篇论文由 Marit Bentvelzen、Pawel W. Wozniak 等作者完成,目前已经被引用 127 次,研究方向涉及Innovative Human-Technology Interaction、Technology Use by Older Adults、Personal Information Management and User Behavior。
用论文自己的话来说:Reflection is a commonly addressed design goal in commercial systems and in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) research.
如果你想快速抓住重点,可以记住这几个关键词:Innovative Human-Technology Interaction、Technology Use by Older Adults、Personal Information Management and User Behavior。
